note: Both sets capture the core facts (design point TSR 9.0 / pitch 0°, optimal TSR 8.5 / pitch −1.0°, 4° max pitch at low wind, force peak near 90 m, Prandtl tip-loss drop outboard 5%), but Set A contains fabricated quotes ('The design point for this rotor pitch...', 'The design tip speed ratio for this blade...') and a sign error giving optimal pitch as +1.0° instead of −1.0°. Set A also misbinds the design-point pitch/TSR to the 'set point tip-speed ratio' condition and adds an unsupported 'maximum CP' condition. Set B's main flaw is labeling TSR 8.5 as the 'design point' TSR (it is the optimal) plus a couple of misbound set-point conditions and lightly paraphrased quotes, so it is the more faithful set overall.
